description: This file contains a Smarty plugin defining the {html_options} function, which generates HTML <option> tags for select elements based on passed parameters, including support for options groups and selected states.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_options
methods.description: Generates HTML <select> element with options based on parameters, supporting options, values, selected states, and additional attributes.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_options_optoutput
methods.description: Creates individual <option> tags or option groups for the select element, handling selected states and object values.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_options_optgroup
methods.description: Creates an <optgroup> with nested options for grouped select options.
